title: What If the Oceans Rose Just Three Feet?

scenes.text: What if the oceans rose just three feet? Millions live at the coast.
At about one meter by 2100, parts of New York and San Francisco could flood every day.
Miami could flood with nearly every high tide.
In the United States, a rise of about 0.9 meters puts more than four million people at risk.
Double it to 1.8 meters, and the number jumps to about thirteen million. Nearly half live in Florida.
And these numbers leave out storm surges and melting ice sheets. Three feet is the gentle version.
